forecasts.reason: Theory: a 4-sample mean is 1/4 the stored draw (184) plus 3/4 the model mean, and that one draw is the only estimate of the mean; spread comes from the per-draw sd of about 6 (3/4 x 6 for the mean estimate, combined with 3 new draws).
Theory: a 2-sample mean is half the stored Bernoulli draw (183) plus one new draw around the same mean (seed adds nothing systematic), so sd is about 0.5 x sqrt(6^2+6^2), roughly 4.
Theory: half the stored draw (166) plus one new independent draw around the same mean, sd about 4 from the run-to-run spread of 6 on hard328.
Theory: adding samples to a vote moves only the few problems it can flip, so the vote over 9 stays near the stored vote over 4 (446), plus a few problems; spread of about 5-6 on MATH-500.
Theory: 3 more samples after 9 flip only a problem or two, so the vote is near the stored 4-vote 446 plus a few; MATH-500 spread of about 5-6.

Theory: seed adds nothing systematic, and answers cut at 16,384 are equivalent to a cap-16,384 run, so the new 4-vote equals the stored Think-SFT cue 4-vote (241) within a run-to-run spread of about 5.
